strengths: Name/type are prefilled and Save Changes is concise; desktop width is appropriate for reading/editing.

issues.observation: Editing an existing Hybrid still displays all five definitions and three levels of repeated ‘strain details’ wording. The help block consumes216px on mobile and pushes optional fields below the fold.
issues.recommendation: Apply the add-form simplification here: ‘Edit strain’, then fields without another details heading; show only selected-type help on demand. Use ‘Name’, ‘Type’, ‘Lineage’ and define the different purposes of description and notes.

limits: No values edited or save submitted; sparse optional fields reflect the synthetic fixture.

pass2.notes: Fresh desktop/mobile revisits confirm the same five-definition helper block is displayed even with Hybrid selected, adding about 216px on mobile. The selected value and form labels remain readable. No edit or save occurred.
